property_summary: For any actor whose Kilos balance is nonzero, calling collectDrugs after a full production period must increase that actor's Kilos by at least one (Kilos[actor] strictly grows), but the mutant never adds new kilos so Kilos stays frozen.
change_summary: Delete the statement that adds newly produced kilos to Kilos[msg.sender], so Kilos never increases during collectDrugs.
